entities.name: Ľudovít Štúr Institute of Linguistics

entities.summary: Štúr Institute of Linguistics of the Slovak Academy of Sciences is a primary research institution in the Slovak Republic. It is named after Ľudovít Štúr, the most important leader of the Slovak national revival.
